info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Customer By Account Id-spec
info.description: The Customer Account Deletion API allows for the removal of specific customer account associations based on the provided customer and account identifiers. This operation is crucial for maintaining accurate customer records and compliance within the system. Typical use cases include data cleansing and handling customer account requests from internal teams or integration partners. This API ensures that customer information is managed effectively and securely by enabling authorized users to delete obsolete or incorrect account links.

delete.description: This operation allows you to remove a specified account associated with a particular customer. Ensure that the account is not linked to any active transactions or services before proceeding with the deletion.

requestBody.description: This request body defines the parameters required to delete the specified account associated with the given customer. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to delete this account before proceeding.

204.description: The resource was deleted successfully with no content returned.

DeleteCustomerByAccountIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation on a specific account.

DeleteCustomerByAccountIdResponse_204.title: Delete Account Response
DeleteCustomerByAccountIdResponse_204.description: The schema representing the response for a DELETE operation on a specific account.
